A '''zombie''' wielding a [[bronze hatchet]] could be encountered during the [[Temple Trekking]] minigame, during the bridge puzzle event, prior to its rework in 2011. The zombie was guaranteed to drop a [[bronze hatchet]] when killed, which could be used to cut the nearby [[tree]]s for [[logs]] to fill the gaps in the bridge.
